name: Restaurant Bot
description: A chatbot for restaurants handling table reservations, menu inquiries, allergens, hours, and promotions

data.label: Welcome
data.content:
Welcome to our restaurant! How can I help you today?

I can assist with:
- Table reservations
- Menu and allergen information
- Restaurant hours
- Special promotions
- Or connect you with our staff
